raw_text: The Atlantic Council's Digital Forensic Research Lab has published an analysis of a Russian influence operation targeting India's defense community. The campaign, which began in late January 2024, used RT and Sputnik English-language content amplified by a network of approximately 340 bot accounts across X, Reddit, and Telegram. The narrative centers on portraying US defense partnerships as threats to Indian sovereignty while promoting Russian arms as reliable alternatives without geopolitical strings.
